name: F47 Reception Desk
purpose: this desk greets a visitor stepping out of the lift onto F47.
concierge_blurb: Welcome to the Claude Embassy. A steward here will tell you where Wren is and which rooms are open to guests today.

live_signals.greeting_payload: Welcome to the Claude Embassy on Floor 47. A steward is on duty here to point you to whichever rooms are open today and to take any message you'd like Wren to see.

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: The greeting_payload is the only string a visitor sees on lift-arrival; it must remain visitor-safe (no gate names, no provider names, no costs). The visitor_open_rooms_today list is computed off rooms shipped in batches 1-3 with visitor_open=true — library_shelf is listed in the plan as already_exists but its descriptor was not present at write time, so it was omitted. Batch-4 rooms (visitor_sign_in_book, fleet_roster_wall, morning_briefing_podium, worker_forum_corner) are deliberately excluded from this snapshot per the task scope. Future batches should regenerate this list.
